 Trent McDuffie and Joe Cardona among Rams' inactives for Week 9 at Commanders
 Nov 08, 2026 at 08:49 AM Stu Jackson Senior Staff Writer
 Copied! 
 LANDOVER, Md. – Rams cornerback Trent McDuffie (back) and long snapper Joe Cardona (ankle) are inactive for today's game against the Commanders at Northwest Stadium (10 a.m. PT, FOX).
 Also inactive for Los Angeles are quarterback Ty Simpson (emergency third quarterback), outside linebacker Darryl Peterson III , offensive lineman Bill Murray , offensive lineman Keagen Trost and outside linebacker Desjuan Johnson .
 For the Commanders, wide receiver Treylon Burks (foot) is inactive – as expected with Burks ruled out on Friday. Wide receiver Dyami Brown (calf), who was already ruled out, was placed on Injured Reserve on Saturday.
 Below are the inactives for both teams.
